headlines.title: Schools closed, services slowed and flights cancelled: strikes hit Portugal
headlines.summary: Three CGTP unions have called a strike for Friday, disrupting schools, public services, councils and rubbish collection. An easyJet cabin crew walkout is also causing flight delays nationwide.

headlines.title: Trans-Caspian Corridor: Europe and Central Asia target faster trade
headlines.summary: Transit along the Trans-Caspian Corridor currently takes around 35 days, with a target of cutting this to between 15 and 20. Officials say customs, digital systems and predictable border procedures are as important as new railways and ports.

headlines.title: Le calendrier chargé d’Emmanuel Macron complique sa venue à la COP31
headlines.summary: Bien qu’il aime se poser en défenseur de l’Accord de Paris sur le climat, le chef de l’Etat ne semble plus placer les négociations climatiques en haut de ses priorités calendaires.

headlines.summary: José Sevilla will step down as Unicaja chairman in April 2027 after deciding not to seek a new term, but will retain his non-executive role at the Málaga-based bank until then.

headlines.title: EU watchdogs question Binance over unlicensed European operations
headlines.summary: European regulators are questioning Binance over its use of a narrow legal exemption to keep serving EU customers without a licence, the Financial Times reported. Binance told Euronews it is working towards authorisation, while ESMA said enforcement is a matter for national authorities.
